side mirror, units 1 and 2 crossed onto the improved shoulder due to the driver slightly turning the steering wheel to the right. the driver of unit 1 returned his attention to the front of his vehicle at the exact moment unit 1 struck the left rear of unit 4. the driver of unit 1 immediately [roadway], from the improved shoulder, and traveled closely alongside units 3 and 4. yan broytman, callahan county jp holland. blood specimens were obtained from the driver of unit 1 and yan broytman and results are pending. the driver of unit 1 was not injured in the crash. all units involved were removed from the scene by a local wrecker service and were not inventoried prior to release. on [date], lab analysis reports were received regarding blood specimens obtained from the driver of unit 1 records.deidentified_narrative: while on patrol police responded to a call for an accident major involving a pedestrian. upon arriving i made contact with u2 who stated that he was walking across the southbound lanes of travel on the [roadway]. near the intersection of the [roadway]. when he was struck by an oncoming vehicle. u2 originally stated that he was unsure if the traffic control signal at the location of the crash was green or red for oncoming traffic, but later stated that he looked up and observed a red light for the oncoming vehicles in the southbound lanes of travel before proceeding into the roadway, walking eastbound. u2 went on to inform me that he observed u1 appear to swerve around u2 as he walked through the above listed roadway, though the front bumper of u1 struck u2's left leg. u2 stated that he was knocked to the ground as a result of the crash, and that u1 fled southbound from the location without making any attempt to stop and render aid or to provide information with u2. u2 then stated that he continued walking eastbound along ih [roadway]. where he began to feel pain from preexisting injuries and sat down near a private business. u2 then requested the help of bystanders in calling for police assistance in completing a report and seeking medical assistance. u2 appeared to have minor injuries as a result of the crash, having sustained visible scratches and and bruising to his lower left leg. u2 was assessed by on-scene safd personnel, though u2 refused medical transport or any further medical assistance. u2 nor a witness who observed the crash were able to provide any identifying information or features of u1, though it was described as being a silver or gray four door sedan. u2 was provided this [case id] and was advised to contact the follow-up unit with additional questions or details on this incident and to aid in pressing charges on the unknown driver of u1. i cleared the scene without further incident. body camera and coban available. see offense report under this [case id] for additional details on this incident.

records.deidentified_narrative: on [date] at approximately 0010 hours, i, officer fadorsen 3907 and officer ortiz 3902 were dispatched to 5300 fm 78 in kirby texas for a motor vehicle vs pedestrian crash. upon arrival, we positioned our units to block the westbound lanes of fm 78. i observed a male, identified as thibodeau, christopher w/m [date] laying on the side of fm 78 with obvious injuries to his head as there was blood streaming down his face and pooling under his head. i also noticed the left side of his torso to be injured. acadian ems unit # 731 who just happened to be driving by stopped and began an immediate assessment of the victim. emts stated that thibodeau appeared to have a fractured skull and a broken rib. i later learned that thibodeau was admitted to the intensive care unit (bamc) [medical facility] (bamc), the number to which is [phone]. thibodeau was subsequently transported by acadian 731 to bamc for treatment. the began their work to stabilize thibodeau and i began my investigation. ortiz made contact with the driver, identified as davis, travis w/m [date] and i went to inspect the vehicle. the vehicle davis was driving was a grey ford focus bearing tx lp [identifier] [roadway] approximately 50 to 100 yards from where thibodeau was laying. the vehicle had severe damage to the front bumper and hood as well as a totally cracked windshield where thibodeaus head likely hit. i know the speed [roadway] to be 50 miles per hour, however based on the severity of the damage, i believe davis was likely driving over the speed limit as modern windshields are made of a laminated safety glass to prevent shatter and daviss windshield was completely broken through. the metal on the hood was severely impacted and dented almost to the point of rendering the hood inoperable. i did not observe any open alcohol containers in the vehicle; however, i did notice music equipment, more specifically a keyboard or guitar case which is indicative of musicians who perform at live venues where alcohol is typically consumed. i asked davis what was in the case and he confirmed that it was in fact a keyboard. davis stated that he was playing at a live venue downtown san antonio. davis also admitted to drinking beer at dinner. i know from my own experience in the music scene that performers at live music venues that serve alcohol often consume alcohol while performing. davis stated he was not injured and refused medical. i asked ortiz to perform horizontal gaze nystagmus (hgn) on davis to ensure that davis was not intoxicated due to his admission to drinking alcohol. once fire units departed the scene, we both shut down out overhead emergency red and blue lights in order to conduct hgn. i asked davis if he hit his head at the time of the crash, he stated he had not. ortiz conducted hgn. as i observed the test, i did observe lack of smooth pursuit. i also observed davis repeatedly close his eyes numerous times which, in my experience, is abnormal human behavior and was likely done to invalidate and/or cheat the hgn test. i also observed davis repeatedly break his position that he was instructed to hold and was moving his hands around and would not keep them down to his side as instructed. davis also kept gazing passed the stimuli during the hgn likely in an attempt to invalidate the test ortiz was conducting. davis then refused any further testing by stating id rather not go any further. once ortiz stopped the test, davis attempted to walk to his car and appeared extremely unsteady on his feet and stumbled quite a bit. officers had to call out to him to stop and redirect him back to where we were. davis then sat down on his own. i then made a phone call to cid det. rendon to seek guidance due to the severity of the situation and what the next steps would be that i needed to take. based on daviss refusal of hgn, further standardized field sobriety tests (sfsts), and his self-admission to consuming alcohol, i believe that davis was operating his vehicle at the time of the accident intoxicated. after conferring with rendon, [roadway] davis under arrest for dwi. davis was handcuffed (double locked). davis was searched incident to arrest and no contraband was located. after davis was placed in my patrol vehicle #4103, i then processed the vehicle for impounding. i removed daviss music equipment from the vehicle for safe keeping at the kpd property room due to its value and to reduce liability on the kpd. i also placed a hold on the vehicle pending a criminal case, especially if thibodeau succumbs to his injuries and the case is upgraded to manslaughter. i then requested dispatch to run a computerized criminal history on davis which showed a previous 2014 conviction for driving while intoxicated in kendall county texas. the vehicle was towed by roadrunner wrecker service to 100 pecan san antonio texas. once the music equipment was removed from the vehicle, there was nothing of significant value in the car. after roadrunner left with the vehicle, i transported davis to kpd for processing. since davis was being cooperative, i uncuffed him and placed him in cell 1 while we completed all our paperwork. at 0209 hrs, i mirandized davis who subsequently evoked his right to silence and refused to answer any questions. ortiz read the dic-24 statutory warning and requested a voluntary sample of daviss blood, to which davis refused. with this refusal, i seized daviss drivers license in accordance with state law. the investigation on fm 78, the miranda warning and the dic 24 reading were all captured on kpd bwc 3907 and 3902. i transported davis to the bexar county jail where i obtained a blood warrant and collected a sample of davis's blood. thibodeau was walking along fm 78 in violation of trc 552. 006 at the time of the crash. davis was charged with intox assault.

records.public_safe_text: on [date] at approximately 0010 hours, i, officer fadorsen 3907 and officer ortiz 3902 were dispatched to 5300 fm 78 in kirby texas for a motor vehicle vs pedestrian crash. upon arrival, we positioned our units to block the westbound lanes of fm 78. i observed a male, identified as thibodeau, christopher w/m [date] laying on the side of fm 78 with obvious injuries to his head as there was blood streaming down his face and pooling under his head. i also noticed the left side of his torso to be injured. acadian ems unit # 731 who just happened to be driving by stopped and began an immediate assessment of the victim. emts stated that thibodeau appeared to have a fractured skull and a broken rib. i later learned that thibodeau was admitted to the intensive care unit (bamc) [medical facility] (bamc), the number to which is [phone]. thibodeau was subsequently transported by acadian 731 to bamc for treatment. the began their work to stabilize thibodeau and i began my investigation. ortiz made contact with the driver, identified as davis, travis w/m [date] and i went to inspect the vehicle. the vehicle davis was driving was a grey ford focus bearing tx lp [identifier] [roadway] approximately 50 to 100 yards from where thibodeau was laying. the vehicle had severe damage to the front bumper and hood as well as a totally cracked windshield where thibodeaus head likely hit. i know the speed [roadway] to be 50 miles per hour, however based on the severity of the damage, i believe davis was likely driving over the speed limit as modern windshields are made of a laminated safety glass to prevent shatter and daviss windshield was completely broken through. the metal on the hood was severely impacted and dented almost to the point of rendering the hood inoperable. i did not observe any open alcohol containers in the vehicle; however, i did notice music equipment, more specifically a keyboard or guitar case which is indicative of musicians who perform at live venues where alcohol is typically consumed. i asked davis what was in the case and he confirmed that it was in fact a keyboard. davis stated that he was playing at a live venue downtown san antonio. davis also admitted to drinking beer at dinner. i know from my own experience in the music scene that performers at live music venues that serve alcohol often consume alcohol while performing. davis stated he was not injured and refused medical. i asked ortiz to perform horizontal gaze nystagmus (hgn) on davis to ensure that davis was not intoxicated due to his admission to drinking alcohol. once fire units departed the scene, we both shut down out overhead emergency red and blue lights in order to conduct hgn. i asked davis if he hit his head at the time of the crash, he stated he had not. ortiz conducted hgn. as i observed the test, i did observe lack of smooth pursuit. i also observed davis repeatedly close his eyes numerous times which, in my experience, is abnormal human behavior and was likely done to invalidate and/or cheat the hgn test. i also observed davis repeatedly break his position that he was instructed to hold and was moving his hands around and would not keep them down to his side as instructed. davis also kept gazing passed the stimuli during the hgn likely in an attempt to invalidate the test ortiz was conducting. davis then refused any further testing by stating id rather not go any further. once ortiz stopped the test, davis attempted to walk to his car and appeared extremely unsteady on his feet and stumbled quite a bit. officers had to call out to him to stop and redirect him back to where we were. davis then sat down on his own. i then made a phone call to cid det. rendon to seek guidance due to the severity of the situation and what the next steps would be that i needed to take. based on daviss refusal of hgn, further standardized field sobriety tests (sfsts), and his self-admission to consuming alcohol, i believe that davis was operating his vehicle at the time of the accident intoxicated. after conferring with rendon, [roadway] davis under arrest for dwi. davis was handcuffed (double locked). davis was searched incident to arrest and no contraband was located. after davis was placed in my patrol vehicle #4103, i then processed the vehicle for impounding. i removed daviss music equipment from the vehicle for safe keeping at the kpd property room due to its value and to reduce liability on the kpd. i also placed a hold on the vehicle pending a criminal case, especially if thibodeau succumbs to his injuries and the case is upgraded to manslaughter. i then requested dispatch to run a computerized criminal history on davis which showed a previous 2014 conviction for driving while intoxicated in kendall county texas. the vehicle was towed by roadrunner wrecker service to 100 pecan san antonio texas. once the music equipment was removed from the vehicle, there was nothing of significant value in the car. after roadrunner left with the vehicle, i transported davis to kpd for processing. since davis was being cooperative, i uncuffed him and placed him in cell 1 while we completed all our paperwork. at 0209 hrs, i mirandized davis who subsequently evoked his right to silence and refused to answer any questions. ortiz read the dic-24 statutory warning and requested a voluntary sample of daviss blood, to which davis refused. with this refusal, i seized daviss drivers license in accordance with state law. the investigation on fm 78, the miranda warning and the dic 24 reading were all captured on kpd bwc 3907 and 3902. i transported davis to the bexar county jail where i obtained a blood warrant and collected a sample of davis's blood. thibodeau was walking along fm 78 in violation of trc 552. 006 at the time of the crash. davis was charged with intox assault.
